results.title: Tamworth Thunderbolts ‘miracle on the court’ to claim Waratah League title
results.description: Tamworth pulled off a comeback for the ages to clinch the Waratah League championship over Moss Vale at the weekend. The Thunderbolts turned around a 15-point deficit to claim their second title in three seasons.
